caller_is_validator.meaning: the caller of the batch settlement path holds the validator role

standard_path_kyc_gated.meaning: standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn paths revert when the recipient (and holder for mint/burn) is not marked isKycVerified

source_holds_funds.meaning: a KYC-verified address holds funds in the ledger that a validator can move

destination_kyc_verified.meaning: the destination address is marked isKycVerified (false for the non-KYC/sanctioned destination)

batch_path_kyc_gated.meaning: the validator batch settlement path (batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers) enforces the same isKycVerified recipient gating as standard flows, so funds cannot be moved to a recipient not marked isKycVerified

kyc_guarantee_reliable.meaning: on-chain KYC transfer gating remains reliable for downstream integrators relying on it

assumptions: The batch settlement call is the checked action; the validator is treated as the privileged caller regardless of whether it is malicious or compromised.
The non-KYC destination is the recipient of the batch settlement; onward routing to KYC accounts is possible but not required for this claim.
No concrete amounts or prior balances are given; the claim is about the gating relation, not a numeric quantity.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the token was paused at the time of the batch call; the pause-bypass intent is not part of this KYC-gating claim.
Report does not define a concrete observable for downstream integrator reliance beyond the qualitative reliability of KYC gating; represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: Formalizes only the KYC-gating relation for impact_regulatory_risk; the pause-bypass impact is handled in a separate claim pass.
The reliability of on-chain KYC guarantees is encoded as a qualitative Boolean because the report gives no numeric or structural definition.
The validator's maliciousness and the non-KYC recipient's onward routing are possibilities, not established facts; the claim covers the batch path's gating relation.
